passage:
Dear Customer Service Team,

I am writing to share my disappointment with the home organization service I booked with your company last Thursday. I hired your team to help declutter and organize my home office and garage before I started working remotely from home. Unfortunately, the actual service fell well short of the standards promised on your website.

The main problem was the poor quality of work and the rushed attitude of the two organizers sent to my house. They arrived an hour late and immediately seemed in a rush to finish the job as quickly as possible. Instead of carefully sorting through my office files and storage bins with me as planned, they dumped boxes onto the floor and stuffed items into random plastic containers without labeling anything. When I tried to give guidance, the lead worker told me they had another appointment across town and needed to leave soon.

Because of this rushed work, my office is now more disorganized than it was before they came. Important tax files are mixed up with old magazines, and several expensive storage bins I bought for the project were left completely empty in the garage. Worse still, I noticed that a small wireless keyboard and a set of desk organizers are missing from my work table. While I am not accusing anyone directly, the items were on my desk right before the team started working and disappeared by the time they rushed out the door.

I have always believed in supporting local businesses, but paying $400 for a service that creates more mess and stress is very frustrating. I expected professional help, not careless handling of my personal belongings.

To resolve this issue fairly, I am requesting the following actions:
Send a senior manager to my home to properly reorganize the office and garage.
Investigate the missing office equipment and provide a replacement or reimbursement.
Issue a 50 percent refund for the poor service provided last week.

I have attached photos of the disorganized spaces and my original receipt for your review. I hope we can resolve this matter quickly and amicably without needing to take further steps.

I look forward to hearing your response by this Friday.

Sincerely,
Sarah Jenkins | Homeowner
